Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.Artic.type:
∀ (C D : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (t u v : ↑unitInterval),
  LeanMirror.Expr.eval Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.ArticleDefinitions.model
      Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.ArticleDefinitions.mixtureDefinition (v, u, t, D, C, ()) =
    (D.mix C t).cdf ![u, v]

Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.bound.type:
∀ (a : Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.BoundaryParameter) (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
  C.spearmanFootrule = ProbabilityTheory.Copula.RankRegion.RhoFootrule.UpperParameter.footrule a →
    C.spearmanRho =
        Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.upperRho
          (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.RankRegion.RhoFootrule.UpperParameter.footrule a) →
      C = ProbabilityTheory.Copula.RankRegion.RhoFootrule.UpperParameter.copula a

Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.cente.type:
∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (f : ℝ → ℝ),
  Continuous f →
    ∫ (x : Fin 2 → ↑unitInterval), f |↑(x 0) - 1 / 2 + (↑(x 1) - 1 / 2)| ∂C.toMeasure =
      ∫ (x : Fin 2 → ↑unitInterval), f |↑(x 0) - ↑(x 1)| ∂(C.reflect {1}).toMeasure

∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (X : Ω → Fin 2 → ↑unitInterval),
  Measurable X →
    (∀ (i : Fin 2), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => X ω i) ↑μ = MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume) →
      have m := ∫ (ω : Ω), |↑(X ω 0) - 1 / 2 + (↑(X ω 1) - 1 / 2)| ∂↑μ;
      Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.minimumVariance m ≤
        ∫ (ω : Ω), (|↑(X ω 0) - 1 / 2 + (↑(X ω 1) - 1 / 2)| - m) ^ 2 ∂↑μ

Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.condi.type:
∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (u v : ↑unitInterval),
  (Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.conditionalCopies C).cdf ![u, v] =
    ∫ (t : ↑unitInterval), C.conditionalCDF t u * C.conditionalCDF t v

Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.const.type:
∀ {m : ℝ},
  m ∈ Set.Icc 0 (1 / 2) →
    ((∃ C, ∀ᵐ (x : Fin 2 → ↑unitInterval) ∂C.toMeasure, |↑(x 0) - ↑(x 1)| = m) ↔ m = 0 ∨ ∃ N, 0 < N ∧ m = 1 / (2 * ↑N))

Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.earli.type:
∀ (N : ℕ),
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioc (Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.oldContact N) (Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.oldCorner N),
      Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.oldLeftLine N x < Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.upperRho x

∀ (N : ℕ),
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀
      x ∈
        Set.Ico (Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.oldCorner N)
          (Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.oldContact (N + 1)),
      Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.oldRightLine N x < Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.upperRho x

Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.exact.type:
∀ (m v : ℝ),
  (∃ C,
      Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.meanDistance C = m ∧
        Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.distanceVariance C = v) ↔
    m ∈ Set.Icc 0 (1 / 2) ∧
      Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.minimumVariance m ≤ v ∧
        v ≤ Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.maximumVariance m

∀ (r p : ℝ),
  (∃ C, C.spearmanRho = r ∧ C.spearmanFootrule = p) ↔
    p ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / 2) 1 ∧
      ProbabilityTheory.Copula.RankRegion.RhoFootrule.lowerBoundary p ≤ r ∧
        r ≤ Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.upperRho p

Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.finit.type:
∀ (n : ℕ) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))),
  Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.rankingDistance n π ^ 2 / (↑n + 1) +
      (↑n + 1) ^ 3 *
        Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.minimumVariance
          (Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.rankingDistance n π / (↑n + 1) ^ 2) ≤
    Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.rankingSquare n π

∀ (n : ℕ) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))),
  Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.rankingDistance n π / (↑n + 1) ^ 2 ≠ 0 →
    (∀ (N : ℕ), 0 < N → Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.rankingDistance n π / (↑n + 1) ^ 2 ≠ 1 / (2 * ↑N)) →
      0 <
          Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.minimumVariance
            (Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.rankingDistance n π / (↑n + 1) ^ 2) ∧
        Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.rankingDistance n π ^ 2 / (↑n + 1) <
          Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.rankingSquare n π

Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.fixed.type:
∀ (C D : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) {p r : ℝ},
  C.spearmanFootrule = p →
    D.spearmanFootrule = p → C.spearmanRho ≤ r → r ≤ D.spearmanRho → ∃ E, E.spearmanFootrule = p ∧ E.spearmanRho = r

Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.full_.type:
∀ (x y : ℝ),
  x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 →
    y ∈
        Set.Icc (Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.lowerInnerRatio x)
          (Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.upperInnerRatio x) →
      ∃ C, C.chatterjeeXi = x ∧ Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.copulaCorrelationRatio C = y

Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.lower.type: ∀ {p : ℝ}, p ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / 2) 1 → ∃ C, C.spearmanFootrule = p ∧ C.spearmanRho = -1 + 2 * √((1 + 2 * p) / 3) ^ 3

∀ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1,
  ∃ C,
    C.chatterjeeXi = x ∧
      Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.copulaCorrelationRatio C = Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.lowerInnerRatio x

Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.maxim.type:
∀ {m : ℝ},
  m ∈ Set.Icc 0 (1 / 2) →
    ∃ C,
      Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.meanDistance C = m ∧
        Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.distanceVariance C = Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.maximumVariance m

Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.minim.type:
∀ {m : ℝ},
  m ∈ Set.Icc 0 (1 / 2) →
    ∃ C,
      ∫ (x : Fin 2 → ↑unitInterval), |↑(x 0) - ↑(x 1)| ∂C.toMeasure = m ∧
        ∫ (x : Fin 2 → ↑unitInterval), (|↑(x 0) - ↑(x 1)| - m) ^ 2 ∂C.toMeasure =
          Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.minimumVariance m

∀ {m : ℝ},
  m ∈ Set.Icc 0 (1 / 2) →
    (Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.minimumVariance m = 0 ↔ m = 0 ∨ ∃ N, 0 < N ∧ m = 1 / (2 * ↑N))

Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.mixab.type:
∀ {m : ℝ},
  m ∈ Set.Icc 0 (1 / 2) →
    InfSet.sInf (Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.mixabilityVariances m) =
      Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.minimumVariance m

∀ {m : ℝ},
  m ∈ Set.Icc 0 (1 / 2) →
    IsLeast (Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.mixabilityVariances m)
      (Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.minimumVariance m)

∀ {m : ℝ},
  m ∈ Set.Icc 0 (1 / 2) →
    (InfSet.sInf (Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.mixabilityVariances m) = 0 ↔ m = 0 ∨ ∃ N, 0 < N ∧ m = 1 / (2 * ↑N))

Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.quart.type:
∃ C,
  C.chatterjeeXi = 1 / 4 ∧
    Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.copulaCorrelationRatio C ≤ 256 / 525 ∧
      ∀ (D : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
        D.chatterjeeXi = 1 / 4 →
          Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.copulaCorrelationRatio D ≤
            Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.copulaCorrelationRatio C

∃ e,
  0 < e ∧
    ∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
      C.chatterjeeXi = 1 / 4 → Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.copulaCorrelationRatio C ≤ 1 / 2 - e

Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.ranki.type:
∀ (n : ℕ) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))),
  Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.rankingSquare n π =
      Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.rankingDistance n π ^ 2 / (↑n + 1) ↔
    ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), |↑↑(π i) - ↑↑i| = Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.rankingDistance n π / (↑n + 1)

∀ (n N : ℕ),
  0 < N →
    ((∃ π,
        Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.rankingDistance n π / (↑n + 1) ^ 2 = 1 / (2 * ↑N) ∧
          Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.rankingSquare n π =
            Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.rankingDistance n π ^ 2 / (↑n + 1)) ↔
      2 * N ∣ n + 1)

∀ {m : ℝ},
  m ∈ Set.Icc 0 (1 / 2) →
    ∃ π,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.rankingDistance n (π n) / (↑n + 1) ^ 2) Filter.atTop
          (nhds m) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.rankingSquare n (π n) / (↑n + 1) ^ 3) Filter.atTop
          (nhds (m ^ 2 + Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.minimumVariance m))

∀ (n : ℕ) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))),
  Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.meanDistance (Verification.PermutationShuffle.copula n π) =
    Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.rankingDistance n π / (↑n + 1) ^ 2

∀ (n : ℕ) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))),
  ∫ (x : Fin 2 → ↑unitInterval), (↑(x 0) - ↑(x 1)) ^ 2 ∂(Verification.PermutationShuffle.copula n π).toMeasure =
    Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.rankingSquare n π / (↑n + 1) ^ 3

∀ {m : ℝ},
  m ∈ Set.Icc 0 (1 / 2) →
    ∃ π,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.rankingDistance n (π n) / (↑n + 1) ^ 2) Filter.atTop
          (nhds m) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.rankingSquare n (π n) / (↑n + 1) ^ 3) Filter.atTop
          (nhds ((1 - √(1 - 2 * m) ^ 3) / 3))

Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.sharp.type:
∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
  have m := ∫ (x : Fin 2 → ↑unitInterval), |↑(x 0) - ↑(x 1)| ∂C.toMeasure;
  m ^ 2 + Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.minimumVariance m ≤
    ∫ (x : Fin 2 → ↑unitInterval), (↑(x 0) - ↑(x 1)) ^ 2 ∂C.toMeasure

Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.upper.type:
∀ {p : ℝ},
  p ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / 2) 1 → ∃ C, C.spearmanFootrule = p ∧ C.spearmanRho = Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.upperRho p
∀ p ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / 2) 1, ∃! C, C.spearmanFootrule = p ∧ C.spearmanRho = Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.upperRho p

∀ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1,
  ∃ C,
    C.chatterjeeXi = x ∧
      Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.copulaCorrelationRatio C = Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.upperInnerRatio x

Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.xi_co.type:
∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
  Max.max 0 (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.RankRegion.RhoFootrule.lowerBoundary C.chatterjeeXi) ≤
      Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.copulaCorrelationRatio C ∧
    Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.copulaCorrelationRatio C ≤
      Min.min (Papers.AnsariRockel2026RhoFootrule.upperRho C.chatterjeeXi) (2 * C.chatterjeeXi)
